name: proposal-workbench
description: Evidence-backed proposal and RFP workbench for turning Perplexity research, URLs, RFPs, and briefs into proposal blocks, storyboard gates, task packs, and verifier close gates.

interface.shortDescription: Turn research and RFP inputs into verified proposal work packages.
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin for structuring Perplexity project candidates, RFPs, URLs, and raw briefs into evidence matrices, proposal blocks, storyboard gates, execution boards, and close-gate verification notes before deck production.
defaultPrompt: Turn this RFP into evidence-backed proposal blocks.
Build a storyboard gate for this proposal idea.
Create a task pack and verifier close gate.
